Subject: Your consumer complaint matter - CC/1039/2025

Dear Mr. Rajan,

Thank you for meeting us on 4 May 2026 about your dispute with Emerald Realty. As we understand it, possession of the flat is long overdue. The matter is listed before the Warangal District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission.

Our advice is to claim interest on the amount paid for every month of delay in possession. Please collect the allotment letter, the builder-buyer agreement and every payment receipt and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
